description: PostgreSQL 18 array construction, bounds-aware subscripts and slices, assignment, operators, and scalar functions
sql: CREATE TABLE type_matrix_array_operations (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, values_int INT4[], labels TEXT[], matrix INT4[], note TEXT);
INSERT INTO type_matrix_array_operations VALUES ('bounded', '[0:2]={10,20,30}'::INT4[], '{alpha,beta,gamma}'::TEXT[], '[0:1][5:6]={{1,2},{3,4}}'::INT4[], 'before');
SELECT ARRAY[1,2,3] AS one_dimension, ARRAY[ARRAY[1,2], ARRAY[3,4]] AS two_dimensions, ARRAY[]::INT4[] AS empty_array;
SELECT values_int[0] AS at_lower, values_int[1] AS at_one, values_int[-1] AS below_lower, values_int[3] AS above_upper FROM type_matrix_array_operations WHERE id = 'bounded';

SELECT values_int[0:1] AS bounded_slice, values_int[:1] AS open_lower, values_int[1:] AS open_upper, values_int[-5:20] AS clipped_slice, values_int[2:1] AS empty_slice FROM type_matrix_array_operations WHERE id = 'bounded';
UPDATE type_matrix_array_operations SET values_int[0] = 99 WHERE id = 'bounded';
SELECT values_int, array_dims(values_int) FROM type_matrix_array_operations WHERE id = 'bounded';
UPDATE type_matrix_array_operations SET values_int[-1] = 7 WHERE id = 'bounded';
UPDATE type_matrix_array_operations SET values_int[4] = 40 WHERE id = 'bounded';
SELECT values_int, array_dims(values_int) FROM type_matrix_array_operations WHERE id = 'bounded';
UPDATE type_matrix_array_operations SET labels[2] = 'BETA', note = 'after, where preserved' WHERE id = 'bounded';
UPDATE type_matrix_array_operations SET values_int[0:1] = ARRAY[8,9] WHERE id = 'bounded';
UPDATE type_matrix_array_operations SET matrix[0][5] = 11 WHERE id = 'bounded';
UPDATE type_matrix_array_operations SET matrix[0:0][5:6] = ARRAY[[12,13]] WHERE id = 'bounded';

SELECT labels, note, values_int, array_dims(values_int), matrix, matrix[0] AS incomplete_subscript, matrix[0][5] AS matrix_element, matrix[0:0][5:5] AS matrix_slice FROM type_matrix_array_operations WHERE id = 'bounded';

SELECT ARRAY[1,2] || ARRAY[3,4] AS array_cat, 0 || ARRAY[1,2] AS scalar_prepend, ARRAY[1,2] || 3 AS scalar_append, ARRAY[[1,2],[3,4]] || ARRAY[[5,6]] AS matrix_cat, ARRAY[1,2] || ARRAY[[3,4]] AS rank_promoted_cat;

SELECT ARRAY[1,2] = ARRAY[1,2] AS equal_arrays, ARRAY[1,2] < ARRAY[1,3] AS element_order, ARRAY[1,2,3] > ARRAY[1,2] AS length_order, '[0:1]={1,2}'::INT4[] = '[1:2]={1,2}'::INT4[] AS bounds_equal, '[0:1]={1,2}'::INT4[] < '[1:2]={1,2}'::INT4[] AS bounds_order;
SELECT ARRAY[1,2] @> ARRAY[2,2] AS contains_duplicates, ARRAY[1,2] <@ ARRAY[0,1,2] AS is_contained, ARRAY[1,2] && ARRAY[2,3] AS overlaps, ARRAY[1,2] && ARRAY[3,4] AS disjoint;
SELECT array_append(ARRAY[1,2], 3), array_prepend(0, ARRAY[1,2]), array_cat(ARRAY[1,2], ARRAY[3,4]), array_remove(ARRAY[1,NULL,2,NULL], NULL), array_replace(ARRAY[1,2,1], 1, 9);
SELECT array_position(ARRAY['a','b','a'], 'a'), array_position(ARRAY['a','b','a'], 'a', 2), array_positions(ARRAY['a',NULL,'a'], NULL), array_position(ARRAY['a','b'], 'z');
SELECT array_fill(7, ARRAY[2,3]), array_fill(7, ARRAY[2], ARRAY[0]), trim_array(ARRAY[1,2,3,4], 2), array_sample(ARRAY[1,2,3], 0), cardinality(array_shuffle(ARRAY[]::INT4[]));
SELECT array_to_string(ARRAY['a',NULL,'c'], ',', '*'), string_to_array('a,,c', ','), string_to_array('a,NULL,c', ',', 'NULL');
SELECT array_append('{{1,2},{3,4}}'::INT4[], 5);
SELECT array_remove('{{1,2},{3,4}}'::INT4[], 1);
SELECT array_position('{{a,b},{c,d}}'::TEXT[], 'a');
